financials_multi_year.source: Mashreqbank FY2025 Audited Financial Statements, read 22-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 assets AED 335bn (+25% YoY), deposits AED 205bn (+27% YoY, 62% CASA), operating income AED 12.6bn, PBT AED 8.3bn, PAT AED 7.0bn, NPL 1.0%.

9M26 assets surged +33% YoY to AED 405.6bn, loans AED 190.6bn (+33% YoY), deposits AED 237.1bn (+27% YoY), NPAT AED 6.1bn (+18% YoY; PBT AED 7.3bn), ROE 20.4%, NPL 0.7% (311% coverage, AED 116m net impairment release), CAR 16.7%, LCR 124%.

verdict.summary: Standout growth and profitability among GCC A-rated private banks: 9M26 NPAT +18% YoY to AED 6.1bn (20.4% ROE) as assets surpassed AED 405.6bn (+33% YoY) with 0.7% NPLs and 311% coverage. Rapid 33% loan expansion is backed by 16.7% CAR (boosted by Feb-26 $500m 6.25% AT1) and 124% LCR.

positives: Top-quartile profitability: 20.4% ROE in 9M26 (+18% YoY NPAT to AED 6.1bn) with strong non-interest income (+18% YoY to AED 3.9bn).
Stellar asset quality: NPL ratio down to 0.7% (vs 1.1% Sep-25) with 311% coverage and AED 116m net impairment release.
Strong capital & liquidity: 16.7% CAR, 124% LCR, 80% LDR, A/A3/A Stable ratings.
negatives: Aggressive balance sheet expansion: +33% YoY loan growth (incl. +13% QoQ in Q3) and +75% investment book (AED 83.7bn) warrant credit-cycle vigilance.
Private-family majority ownership (Al Ghurair) vs sovereign-owned peers (FAB/ADCB/ENBD), though systemic importance in Dubai is high.
Regional expansion (Egypt, Pakistan, Turkey, Oman) increases cross-border macro sensitivity.

background.business_overview: UAE's oldest privately owned commercial bank (est. 1967), digital banking leader across corporate, investment banking, and retail.
background.asset_perimeter: Core UAE franchise plus international wholesale/digital hubs in Egypt, GCC, UK, US, and Pakistan.
background.ownership_governance: Controlled by Al Ghurair family (~85%+); listed on DFM and regulated by Central Bank of the UAE.

2026 Issuance: Priced $500m 6.25% Perp NC5.5 AT1 ($2.1bn book) in Feb-26 and $500m 5Y senior bond in Q3-26.
